cohort: The cohort consisted of 37 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) managed with Flash Glucose Monitoring (FGM) and 74 matched GDM women managed with self-monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG).
finding: Flash Glucose Monitoring (FGM) use was well accepted by patients, safe, and non-inferior to self-monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG) in terms of perinatal outcomes, gestational weight gain, and HbA1c progression in GDM pregnancies.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in C-section rates between the FGM and SMBG groups.
